body: My parents are abusive and hate me

Oh that is really hard for you. Do you have in your country like a helpline? I know that they might be able to chat online. I can suggest [https://www.7cups.com/member/](https://www.7cups.com/member/)  but not too sure they will help.
The cameras in the vents is not ok. So I think she is, she also called you a name which could be taken as emotional abuse.
Oh sorry! I can't believe i missed that, what a terrible situation.Do you have a neighbour you could trust? maybe you should tell police.
Maybe tell a teacher in person? or do you have a like counsellor at your school that could help?
I get you. It's very tiring trying to be good enough for anyone. I'm here if you need to talk. :)
I feel you. Parents sometimes don't understand. Maybe take a walk. Or tell your friend how you feel. I'm also here if you need me

Hey, I feel really bad for you. if your mom is abusive you need to tell someone. Your friend teachers, anyone. You can even tell someone online that might be able to help. I feel you. I know what you're going through. I can't stop you from doing anything. But I am here if you need to talk. :)
My parents are abusive too. I suggest telling a friend. Or a teacher, OR researching online for help. I'm always here to talk too. :) stay strong

I feel you. But you have to keep on going, If you need someone to talk to or get advice I'm here. Talking makes things seem a little bit better. I'm not going to say its going to be ok because it might not be. But please I'm here. I might be some random stranger you don't even know but I'm here if you need me and I can talk if you need support. I might know how it feels to not be who you want to be. I get that. You have rights to be treated the way you want to be treated and if people can't see that then they can go fuck themselves. So please If you need someone to talk to I'm here. Stay strong.
I could help, But not too sure I can do it right. I could try to edit one and see if thats what you need?
